sampling: Actual STATS pre-edge freeze; all independent ledgers use nonblocking updates. A same-edge request is excluded from this packet. Reserve-denied wins over coincident request busy increment; publication resets age after request increment. Completed metadata B precedes engine finished/publication fence, which precedes STATS.

fields.name: requests
fields.expected: Independent modulo96M UI active run&&!stop clock ledger, reset at reset; increment every real request interval, not DUT tick/counter.

fields.name: accepted
fields.expected: Count actual reserve_ack while reserve request pending; match real lease slot ownership and resulting capture arm.

fields.name: busy_rejected
fields.expected: Request interval while backend not IDLE plus reserve_denied while pending; same-edge single-counter priority recorded explicitly.

fields.name: capture_drop
fields.expected: Independent invalid capture descriptor event at CAPTURE/FREEZE or own capture-active deadline with drained transfer; normal subcase requires zero and no invalid/timeout event.

fields.name: published
fields.expected: Real successful physical metadata B for current job plus engine finished/published fence and matching accepted descriptor. Never DUT published_count/publication counter.

fields.name: result_age
fields.expected: Request-interval count since last independently fenced publication; publication resets age.

fields.name: camera_max
fields.expected: Independent maximum camera occupancy camera_bytes sampled each UI edge, reset0.

fields.name: display_min
fields.expected: Independent minimum display_bytes while actual video lease held, reset8192.

fields.name: max_wait[3]
fields.expected: Per-client pre-edge valid&&!ready increments saturating u32 waiting, else clears; max compares prior waiting. Only reset resets these maxima, not DDR ACK.

fields.name: max_service[3]
fields.expected: Real client address accept initializes age0; each following owned edge increments up to actual TX_LIMIT; real finalR/B uses pre-terminal age for max. Only reset resets max; ACK drains active-age state but cannot fabricate terminal.

fields.name: engine_scans_pairs
fields.expected: Little-endian pairs low16/scans high16. Sum successful physical B-committed payload bytes wholly within workA01072000..0108e1ff or workB0108f000..010ab1ff; subtract initialization115200. Require remaining bytes divisible115200, scans even, pairs=scans/2. Exclude unacknowledged W, result copy and metadata. Normal completed publication only.

fields.name: engine_elapsed
fields.expected: Independent u32 saturating ledger reset0 at actual ENGINE start with busy=0; increment on each pre-edge busy=1 including METAW terminal edge which clears busy by NBA. ENGINE_WAIT finished fence next edge; STATS samples final ledger one further edge later. Never metadata_elapsed or DUT elapsed.

fields.name: engine_changed
fields.expected: Independent signed golden class1 pixels reachable in BFS mask (mask && class1), not DUT reached/changed counter; normal complete-engine publication only.

fields.name: system_status
fields.expected: Reconstruct declared backend status interface from cal_done/cal_pass/quarantine/stop/error_reason/ack; input serialization scope explicit.

fields.name: job_id
fields.expected: Independent64bit reserve-accept job ledger; cross-check physical capture metadata job field.

fields.name: source_id
fields.expected: Actual consumed successful capture descriptor source ID with existing physical LCD/M5A identity oracle; not backend frozen counter copy.

fields.name: flags
fields.expected: Explicit sampled control/diagnostic inputs job failure/stop/engine failure/capture-drop sync; normal case zero required by separate protocol/descriptor/deadline ledger.

fields.name: capture_min
fields.expected: Independent minimum actual capture FIFO count*16, reset8192.

fields.name: capture_max
fields.expected: Independent maximum actual capture FIFO count*16, reset0.

fields.name: FIFO_fault_bits
fields.expected: Direct declared FIFO diagnostic input serialization; independently checked zero in normal traffic.

fields.name: protocol_error_counts
fields.expected: Independent physical B/R response, ID/LAST, accepted permission/epoch and transaction-watchdog histories; normal mixed run requires zero across all7words.

fields.name: local_cancels
fields.expected: Count actual transfer cancelled pulses, not local_cancels register.

fields.name: reserved
fields.expected: Exactly zero.

full_stream: Unchanged strict no-recovery complete header/length/CRC framing, full230400Bclass/115200Bmask andtype4 snapshot/event checks. Type1 compares all256 bytes with an independent expected record.
boundaries: Declared status/FIFO inputs are serialization checks; not an independent proof of their whole producer semantics. Their zero-error normal condition separately checked.
Normal mixed run only for engine_changed BFS expectation; deliberately aborted/fault engine needs a separate partial-work oracle and is not included.
Coverage remains pending until concrete implementation, compilation, native event records and software decoding pass. No active run gains retroactive instrumentation.
implementation_boundaries: Normal complete publications only; source descriptor latched from real capture consume and compared to published engine descriptor; independent physical B is required.
No same-edge newly scheduled NBA counter value enters STATS expectation.
